model_label_basis: Session-displayed GPT-6 Astra Pro label; no independent backend-model introspection was performed.

execution_context.method_environment: Separate internal coder-B subagent context in the shared managed workspace. No web access or repository history was used.

start_time_scope: Timestamp recorded after the initial two-input read and before the first coding judgment was written; the initial long input read immediately preceded this recorded timestamp.

method.judgment: The coder directly judged every one of the 198 units using only CODEBOOK.md and sample/units.json as evidence. S1 and form were judged from candidate and candidate_description; S2 used the problem, proposal, configuration and constraints. Each reason was manually written for its unit.
method.input_display: The initial full packet display was truncated, so the same packet was reread in ordered batches. Exact repeated problem text was displayed once with a stable problem index; candidate, description, constraints, proposal, configuration and packet limitation were displayed for every unit. No other evidence files were opened.
method.raw_capture: Manual per-unit judgments were written in batches to coder-b-raw.tsv. No keyword labeling, model-generated code for label inference, missing-row defaults or semantic post-editing was used.
method.serialization: A deterministic serializer copied all raw fields, nested S3 form/contribution and arranged rows in packet order. S3.contribution was manually recorded as the same variable as S2 and equality was checked.
method.validation_scope: Row count, exact ID coverage and uniqueness, TSV column count, enumerated schema values, nonempty reasons, S2/contribution equality, JSON roundtrip, unchanged input hashes and unchanged raw bytes only; no semantic relabeling or agreement analysis.

raw_preservation.serialization_note: The original TSV bytes were preserved; only JSON structure and packet-order serialization were produced.

limitations: This is a nonhuman internal coder using the session-labeled GPT-6 Astra Pro, not an independent human annotation or a separately verified external model.

The packet depends on a prior researcher’s summaries; selection and scope interpretations remaining in those summaries are not newly independent summaries of original sources. No source URLs were opened.
Familiar product and publication names sometimes supplied preexisting knowledge of form or direct relevance; those rows disclose that reliance in reason and generally use medium or low confidence.

Some packets have only a name, an isolated constraint or sparse context. Unknown/none and boundary/context/polysemy warnings reflect the coder’s direct judgment, not evidence of real-world feature correctness.
No H/T suitability judgment, cross-coder comparison or post hoc semantic adjustment was performed.
